messages:
elaine: Quick sync — we have a hard publish window for the performance benchmark blog next Thurs 03/26 10:00 UTC. Need final press roles + who owns outgoing comms. Press kit link: https://redwood.example.com/asset-bench-2026.zip :zipper_mouth_face:

sam (PR): I'll own the media list and embargo notes. Will pull quotes from product and ops. Do we have a single spokesperson? :thinking_face:

elaine: CEO will do a short quote for press pages, but prefer product lead for technical Qs. @mike can you confirm legal signoff ETA for the quote language?

mike (legal): Scanning now. If we keep the quote high-level (no forward-looking revenue claims) I can sign off by EOD tomorrow. If we add perf numbers as claims, need the numbers validated by @juli.

juli (ops): I can validate perf numbers today — will run the verification job and post logs. ETA 4pm PT. Also note: Dedicated customers list needs a heads-up email (we have a prewritten template in /marketing/templates).

andrew: Who's handling journalist inbound routing on publish? We should route to PR first and have a shared mailbox.

sam (PR): I'll set up press@redwood.com to capture inbound and assign. Also will add triage doc and Slack channel #press-triage.

elaine: Great. Two remaining asks: 1) confirm embargo window (is it OK to embargo until publish time?) 2) confirm social lift schedule (short threads + benchmark visual at T+30m).

mike (legal): Embargo until publish time is fine. Just avoid aggregated claims in the header.

juli (ops): Social assets: I have a hero PNG and GIF in the kit. Ops will queue CDN invalidation at T+5m to push images.

press-bot: Publish scheduled by sam for 2026-03-26 10:00 UTC. Reminder will post 24h and 1h before.

andrew: One more: any embargoed briefings? I have a top-tier UK contact asking for an embargoed call. We should approve limited one-on-ones.

elaine: Approve 1:1 embargoed calls with same rules: no extra slides, no leaked numbers beyond kit. Sam, please log attendees.

sam (PR): Will do. I'll circulate the finalized quote and the press distribution list here by tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:

mike (legal): Noted — I requested small language tweaks, will paste them in thread when ready.

juli (ops): Posting perf validation logfile in 30m.

elaine: Thanks team — please react :eyes: when you see the final quote. We'll close this thread once sam confirms distribution.
